definitions.explanation: Money one earns through work, or the activity of earning it. Often refers to a person's take-home pay or livelihood.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}は{稼|かせ}ぎが{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: My earnings are low this month.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{稼|かせ}ぎがいいので{生活|せいかつ}に{余裕|よゆう}がある。
examples.english: He earns well, so he has some financial leeway.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}を{養|やしな}うために、もっと{稼|かせ}ぎのいい{仕事|しごと}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: To support my family, I'm looking for a better-paying job.

notes:
The noun form of {稼|かせ}ぐ (to earn). Refers to the money earned through work, or to earning itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {稼|かせ}ぎがいい: earns well; well-paying
- {稼|かせ}ぎが{少|すく}ない: earns little
- {共稼|ともかせ}ぎ: both spouses working; dual-income
- {出稼|でかせ}ぎ: working away from home

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {収入|しゅうにゅう}: income — more formal and neutral
- {給料|きゅうりょう}: salary — fixed pay from an employer
